questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a hypothetical conditional structure?
options: Had I known the truth, I would have acted differently.
If I had known the truth, I would have acted differently.
Only if I had known the truth would I have acted differently.
Knowing the truth, I would have acted differently.
questions.answer: Only if I had known the truth would I have acted differently.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to highlight the subject of a complex sentence?
options: It was important that he finished the project on time.
What was important was that he finished the project on time.
The project was finished by him on time.
He finished the project on time, which was important.
questions.answer: What was important was that he finished the project on time.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario with a formal tone?
options: She wishes she could travel anywhere in the world.
She wishes she travels anywhere in the world.
She wishes that she travels to Paris.
She wishes to travel to Paris, she could.
questions.answer: She wishes that she travels to Paris.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of ellipsis to maintain coherence in a complex narrative?
options: He left immediately after he received the news, which was unexpected.
He left immediately after he received the news—no one saw him go.
He left immediately after he received the news, but we never found out why.
He left immediately after he received the news; it was a shock to all.
questions.answer: He left immediately after he received the news—no one saw him go.

questions.question: Which sentence uses formal register and a nuanced grammatical choice to express a nuanced conditional relationship?
options: If you were to give me this opportunity, I would seize it immediately.
Had you given me this opportunity, I would have taken it immediately.
You must provide this opportunity for me to act swiftly.
Should you offer this chance, I will take it without hesitation.
questions.answer: If you were to give me this opportunity, I would seize it immediately.
